In Hatzic, the 55+ homes you can buy are Mission Mobile Home Park (manufactured-home park). This page names each building, says what type it is and what the sources show, and covers local rules and the questions buyers ask. Anything no source states is marked unconfirmed.
Mission Mobile Home Park — 34519 Lougheed Hwy (Hatzic)

Listing text for homes in the park states "This has been 55+ mobile park" and records the site influences as "Adult Oriented," with title shown as leasehold not prepaid (non-strata). Pad rents are quoted per listing, not park-wide: two current-era listings show $650 and $671.29 for different units — treat pad rent as UNCONFIRMED park-wide and confirm the figure for the specific pad in the tenancy documents. Park site count: UNCONFIRMED. Do not quote a tax regime for a home here until the PID's jurisdiction is confirmed.
Streets, schools and getting around Hatzic

items.t: The live feed showed 55 results at reading; feed counts change and that count is a snapshot, not a market statistic.

Flood history of the valley floor: the FVRD's Area F history records that a flood in 1948 broke a dyke along Hatzic Lake, the lake grew five times in size to 25 km², and the Hatzic Prairie was largely under water — the lowland parts of this page's ground are Fraser Valley floodplain ground with a documented flood history. A specific property's current flood status, dyke protection and flood-construction requirements: UNVERIFIED at parcel level.

City planning frame (Bench only): the City of Mission's current plan is Official Community Plan Bylaw 6405-2026, which replaces and repeals OCP Bylaw 6350-2025, keeping the same vision, land use framework, mapping and policy direction with a Regional Context Statement added. This City frame does not govern the FVRD parts of the page.

School-district coverage (SD75) and municipal governance are different things — SD75 serves the FVRD valley communities as well as the City. Catchment schools for any specific Hatzic address are UNVERIFIED — no catchment document was opened and no locator run is on record; the presence of Hatzic Elementary and Hatzic Middle School in the Bench does not by itself assign a Hatzic Island or Hatzic Prairie address to them.

ALR context: the FVRD records that the majority of the inhabited Hatzic Valley area is within the Agricultural Land Reserve, with active commercial and hobby farming alongside sparse residential uses. Whether a specific Hatzic parcel is in the ALR: UNVERIFIED at parcel level.

Transit: the West Coast Express runs from Mission City Station in the City — five weekday westbound trains at 5:25–7:25 a.m. reaching Waterfront in 75 minutes, five eastbound returns, no weekend or holiday service. No TransLink or BC Transit service summary for Hatzic Lake, Hatzic Island or Hatzic Prairie was opened in this research, and no official source states drive times from the lake to the station: UNVERIFIED.

Health care: Mission Memorial Hospital, 7324 Hurd Street, Mission, consists of a 25-bed medical inpatient unit and a 20-bed PATH unit (Patient Assessment and Transition Home), as well as a 10-bed Christine Morrison Hospice, and provides primary acute care services, outpatient and inpatient services, general medicine, laboratory and diagnostic services (Fraser Health).
Per-sub-area medians are not published: UNVERIFIED at sub-area level.

Where 55+ housing actually sits in Hatzic: a single verified product — Mission Mobile Home Park on Lougheed Highway. The Bench houses, the lake resort product and the prairie acreages on this page carry no verified 55+ rule.

blocks.text: Local rules and plans in Hatzic

items.t: Manufactured-home parks run on tenancy law, not strata law: Pad tenancies at Mission Mobile Home Park fall under BC's Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act province-wide, whichever side of the City/FVRD line the park sits on: the resident owns the home and rents the pad; pad rent may be raised only once in 12 months on at least three full months' written notice, capped at the provincial limit (2.3% for 2026) plus a proportional share of changes in local government levies and regulated utility fees. Park rules, approval on assignment, and the park's age policy are park documents — read them before writing.

Secondary suites, two frames on one page: Inside the City (Bench only): all secondary suites must be registered with the City, a suite is a self-contained living space in a single family home forming part of the same real estate entity, and suites are not permitted in townhouses or rowhomes. In FVRD Electoral Area F (Prairie): secondary suites are freely permitted with no restrictions related to farm use, but they must be located within the principal dwelling and could not be a separate detached structure such as a garden suite. Which frame applies depends on which side of the City/FVRD line the parcel sits on.

ALR: farmland parcels on the Prairie/Island side that sit in the Agricultural Land Reserve follow the ALC housing frame of one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m² plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha). Whether a specific parcel is in the ALR: UNVERIFIED at parcel level — check the ALC maps for the PID.

City frame (Bench only): Zoning Bylaw 5949-2020 is Mission's zoning bylaw, and Official Community Plan Bylaw 6405-2026 is the current City plan. Neither governs the FVRD parts of this page. FVRD official community plan and zoning bylaws govern Electoral Areas F and G — the specific bylaw numbers and zone names for a given Prairie/Island lot: confirm with the FVRD for the PID.

Property taxes, two systems on one page — confirm the PID first: City of Mission properties (Bench): 2026 taxes were due Thursday, July 2, 2026, with a flat 10% penalty added to any current balances outstanding on July 3, 2026, and additional taxes levied for diking on top of the municipal, school, regional district and BC Assessment levies. Rural (FVRD Prairie/Island) properties: the owner receives the tax notice from the Province's Surveyor of Taxes Office and pays the Province, not the FVRD or the City; under the Taxation (Rural Area) Act, s.11, rural taxes are due July 2, with a 5% penalty on amounts unpaid on July 2 and a further 5% on amounts unpaid on October 31.

blocks.text: The BC rules on 55+ age bylaws, who may own and who may live in a unit, the exemptions and rentals apply in every strata and are explained once, with sources, on the BC 55+ strata rules page.

items.t: The mailing address lies about who governs you — on half this page. Every listing here carries a Mission mailing address, yet a Ferguson Avenue house pays City taxes under City bylaws while a Shook Road property on Hatzic Island or in Hatzic Prairie is FVRD/Province ground with rural taxes (due July 2; 5% after July 2 and a further 5% after October 31). A buyer who budgets Mission's flat 10% for a Prairie or Island parcel has the wrong regime — and vice versa.

Three tenures sit within one feed page at similar prices. The feed's own cards show a fee-simple Bench house, an Everglades use-area lot and a Green Acres pad home as three different assets with different financing, seasonal-use and resale structures — tenure, park/resort rules and any seasonal-use limit must come from the park's or resort's own documents, not the listing card.
The one verified 55+ product here comes with dyke geography and an unsettled tax line.

School district and municipality part company here too. Hatzic Elementary and Hatzic Middle School are confirmed SD75 schools in the Bench, and SD75 serves the FVRD valley communities as well as the City — but no locator result assigns a lake-side or prairie-side address to them, so the school a Hatzic label suggests is not the school a Shook Road address is promised.

The board shelf and the live feed disagree, openly. The feed includes product the residential splits do not count the same way; the exact reconciliation is UNVERIFIED — do not quote a Hatzic "market" from either source alone.

Two suite rulebooks share one page name. A Bench suite is a City registration inside a single family home; a Prairie suite in Area F must sit within the principal dwelling with no detached garden-suite route — the same word, "suite," means a different build on each side of the City/FVRD line running through this page.

faq.q: What 55+ homes can I actually BUY in Hatzic?
faq.a: One verified product: manufactured homes on rented pads at Mission Mobile Home Park (34519 Lougheed Hwy), whose listings state 55+ outright. There is no 55+ strata, seniors rental, care residence or subsidized seniors building with a Hatzic address in any source checked, and the lake resort and park names in the feed (Everglades Resort, Green Acres Mobile Park) are UNCONFIRMED as 55+.

Partly. The Hatzic Bench is inside the City of Mission, but Hatzic Prairie is FVRD Electoral Area F and Hatzic Island is Electoral Area G — the FVRD's housing-needs report lists Area F as "McConnell Creek, Hatzic Prairie" and Area G as "Nicomen Island, Deroche, Dewdney, Hatzic Island" — and all of it carries Mission mailing addresses and sits in the board's Hatzic sub-area.

faq.q: Who do I pay property tax to on a Hatzic property, and what is the penalty?
faq.a: It depends on which Hatzic: Bench properties inside the City of Mission pay the City (2026 taxes due July 2, 2026, flat 10% penalty July 3); Hatzic Prairie and Hatzic Island properties are rural — their owners receive the notice from the Province's Surveyor of Taxes Office and pay the Province, with rural taxes due July 2 and 5% + 5% penalties under the Taxation (Rural Area) Act. Confirm the PID's jurisdiction before budgeting either regime — including for a home at Mission Mobile Home Park, whose parcel-level line is UNVERIFIED in this research.

faq.q: If I buy a manufactured home at Mission Mobile Home Park, what do I own?
faq.a: The home — not the pad. Pad tenancies are under the BC Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act province-wide: increases once in 12 months on three full months' notice, capped at the provincial limit (2.3% for 2026) plus levy/utility pass-throughs. Listings show title as leasehold not prepaid (non-strata) and pad rents per listing ($650 and $671.29 for different units) — confirm the figure for the specific pad and the park's age and assignment rules in the park documents.

faq.q: Are Everglades Resort or Green Acres Mobile Park 55+?
faq.a: UNCONFIRMED. Both names appear in feed listing-card text only; neither was confirmed on a developer, strata or park-manager source in this research, and seasonal-use limits stated in Everglades listing text (for example, full-time use March 1 to October 31 in one card) are likewise listing text only. Do not treat either as a 55+ purchase without the resort's or park's own rules.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or second home for a caregiver or family?
faq.a: It depends on the parcel's government and, for farmland, the ALR: inside the City, a suite must be registered with the City and sits inside a single family home (no suites in townhouses or rowhomes); in Area F, a suite must sit within the principal dwelling (a detached garden suite is not the Area F suite route); on ALR land a second residence must also fit the ALC frame (one additional residence of 90 m² or 186 m² by parcel size). Confirm both overlays for the PID before relying on a second-dwelling plan.
A specific property's current flood status and dyke protection are parcel-specific and UNVERIFIED in this research, so check the PID against the current floodplain mapping before relying on it.

faq.q: Is the "waterfront" real — can I have a dock?
faq.a: The page title says "Hatzic Lake," and listing text claims docks, beach access and waterfront positions for specific Shook Road properties — but no official source opened in this research confirms dock rights, moorage, beach tenure or direct lake frontage for any listed property: UNVERIFIED per property. Confirm shoreline tenure on title and with the resort or park before paying for water access.

faq.q: Where is the hospital, and where is care if I need it later?
faq.a: Mission Memorial Hospital is at 7324 Hurd St in the City (25-bed medical inpatient unit, 20-bed PATH unit, 10-bed Christine Morrison Hospice). For care steps: no assisted-living or care residence in Hatzic appears in BC's Assisted Living Registry — the registered Mission residences are at urban addresses in the city, and the nearest verified 55+ strata ownership is Cherry Lane and Luther Place in the urban core.
